name: srd-framework
description: Backwards-from-success product methodology for AI-native development teams. Define what done looks like, then reverse-engineer the path to get there. Includes Synthetic Demand Validation to forecast whether an offer, creative, copy, feature, or price will sell.

plugins.name: srd-framework
plugins.description: Synthetic Reality Development framework — generates synthetic personas, critical journeys, gap audits, and machine-readable directives, then validates demand by polling those personas as a synthetic consumer panel. Works on codebases, PRDs, or just ideas. Modes: guided dialogue, autonomous, fast audit, and demand validation.
